indications: Treatment of ear, nose, throat, skin, and urinary tract infections.
contraindications: History of hypersensitivity to penicillin or cephalosporins.
warnings: Serious and occasionally fatal hypersensitivity (anaphylactic) reactions have been reported.
dosage_guidance: Adults: 250 mg to 500 mg every 8 hours, or 500 mg to 875 mg every 12 hours.

indications: Relief of mild to moderate pain.
contraindications: Active gastrointestinal bleeding or peptic ulcer disease.
History of severe allergic reaction to aspirin or other NSAIDs.
warnings: Cardiovascular risk: NSAIDs may cause an increased risk of serious cardiovascular thrombotic events.
Gastrointestinal risk: NSAIDs cause an increased risk of serious gastrointestinal adverse events including bleeding and ulceration.
dosage_guidance: Adults: 200 mg to 400 mg every 4 to 6 hours as needed. Maximum daily dose is 1200 mg (OTC) or 3200 mg (prescription).
